### 1. User expression and simulator role
Marguerite Delacroix-Ng (Saugatuck Hearth Bakery LLC) says the bakery missed last month's bill, she wants to stay clear of a disconnection notice, and asks "the least you need to pay today to do that", by bank draft from business checking; she will not pay the not-yet-due bill; identifies by phone 6164127358, EIN last-4 2087 (ZIP 49453 / email if needed). She agrees if "something has to be posted to the account or adjusted before the amount can be worked out"; declines paying the whole balance; authorizes the bank draft herself for exactly the amount given and reads back the confirmation. Target = the bakery's open agreement; action = notice-avoidance bank draft; authorisation = user-owned tool. Simulator passive/conditional.
